title: Feasibility of a Structured Calorie-Restricted Dietary Intervention in Korean Adults with Early Type 2 Diabetes and Obesity: A Pilot Study.
authors: Park SJ, Kim MK, Kim J, Choi JY, Song Y, Kwon HS.
figures: Overview of the calorie restriction intervention in the study. The program consisted of a 6-week weight loss period followed by a 6-week weight maintenance period. Meals were provided during the weight loss period, starting at 800 kcal/day and increasing by 200 kcal with each phase, including the transition (Phase 4).
